text:
Nora: Quick brainstorm  mini-workshop + starter credits + 'activation badge' to nudge follow-up. Hypothesis: visible badge + credits increases 72h active by 18%.
Eli: Nice. Badge idea = small UI chip "Completed Quickstart" visible in dashboard and social share. Encourages follow-on use.
Jun: Cohorts: control | credits_only | workshop_rsvp | workshop_combo. Primary metric: % who generate >=2 successful calls in 72h. Secondary: share rate, retention_d7.
Kai: Traffic: product banner, newsletter, micro-posts in dev forums. Use utm like: ?utm_source=banner&utm_campaign=miniworkshop_badge&arm=workshop_combo.
OnboardBot: Promo pool created: miniworkshop_pool (1500 codes). API: POST /promo/assign {user_id,pool} -> {code,expires_at}. Single-use, 14d expiry.
Nora: Workshop format: 15m demo, 10m live tweak of 2 templates, 5m CTA + badge reveal. Templates: "Quick outreach", "One-paragraph explainer", "Data insight blurb".
Eli: Add an in-app toast for registrants who didn't claim credits: "Claim your starter credits to unlock the Quickstart badge". Send at +24h if no activity.
Jun: Measurement events: signup.source, promo_code, workshop_reg, badge_awarded_ts, first_gen_ts, gen_count_72h. QA: validate with staging account flow.
Kai: Landing snippet (curl) to show on page:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"Summarize product in 2 lines"}'
```
Nora: Owners: Kai = landing + social narrative; Jun = measurement + analysis; Eli = UX badge + toast; OnboardBot = codes & infra. Drafts by Wed EOD.
Eli: Social narrative angle: "Earn a Quickstart badge in 10 minutes" — two variants: dev-first (benchmarks) and PM-first (time saved).
Jun: Label arms: arm_control | arm_credits | arm_workshop | arm_combo. Power note: baseline 10% -> ~1.7k per arm for 80% power; can run 6-week rolling waves.
OnboardBot: Reminder: assign endpoint requires service token from /secrets. Maintenance window 1881300000-1881303600 UTC.
Nora: Cool. I'll assemble a short experiment brief and link it here. Sync Friday 9am PT. :rocket:
